chunks: By my life, there is no slackening or leniency on my part in fighting those who oppose the truth and grope in misguidance.
So fear Allah, O servants of Allah, and flee unto Allah from His wrath; proceed on the path He has laid out for you, and stand firm in what He has bound upon you.
In that case, Ali is the guarantor of your success eventually, even if you do not attain it immediately.
ai.seo_question: What is Imam Ali's promise to those who follow the divine path and fight against misguidance?
ai.summary: In this exhortation from the Battle of Siffin, Imam Ali (peace be upon him) emphasizes that his leadership guarantees victory (falaj) for the faithful, provided they remain steadfast in the truth. He calls for a decisive, uncompromising stance against those who deviate from divine guidance, urging believers to seek refuge in God and fulfill their covenant. This reflects the Shia scholarly view of Ali as the spiritual and military guarantor of success for those who adhere to the Ahl al-Bayt's path.

en.sayed-ali-raza: By my life there will be no regard for anyone or slackening from me in fighting against one who opposes right or gropes in misguidance.
O creatures of Allāh, fear Allāh and flee unto Allāh from His wrath (seek protection in His Mercy). Tread on the path He has laid down for you and stand by what He has enjoined upon you.
In that case ‘Ali would stand surety for your success (salvation) eventually even though you may not get it immediately (i.e. in this world).
